payload.name: Signature 400x200 Under 100KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 400 x 200 signature workflow for 100KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 400 x 200 signature under 100KB workflow for document, job, school, bank, and admin upload pages that require a large signature image plus a 100KB cap. It points to local resize and compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
